ensemble.dataset: existing validation only; reserved IID/OOD test sets untouched
ensemble.limitation: Checkpoints were selected using this validation set; held half is exploratory, not an independent final test. Three seeds can share systematic errors.
ensemble.policy: Accept only support=3 and position spread <= threshold. Calibration: maximize retained groups with >=30 accepted and Wilson upper95 bad fraction <=5%. Otherwise reject all.
ensemble.bad_definition: unmatched predicted group OR matched position error >10 mm; missing GT counted separately

rgb.dataset: same 2000 validation scenes, same disjoint calibration/held families; no reserved tests
limitations: existing validation used for checkpoint selection; exploratory only
no saved exact robot/object masks; dark/neutral pixels unknown, bright-neutral heuristic can fail
predicted boxes z-buffer each other; real unpredicted occluders are not modeled
equal-budget curves use held score quantiles without labels; not deployed thresholds
RGB scoring detects disagreement, not guaranteed correctness or collision-free space

rgb_pairing.policy: max 1/255 per channel and <=32 changed channels across 3 images per scene; original RGB remains inference input

reference.split: same previous calibration/held validation; developmental comparison, not independent test
reference.oracle_policy: Object masks evaluation only; robot masks rendered from object-free scene

robot_state_storage.robot_qpos_columns: Panda arm joints 1..7, then two gripper joints

activeView.camera_housing: configured proxy; not a measured real mount

visual_map.calibration: simulator-known static background depth and known robot mask; foreground from RGB differences

activeView.execution: kinematic simulation, no hardware or torque controller
activeView.active_view_gain: heuristic prediction, not measured neural-model improvement

limitations: small balanced fresh simulation pilot, not real-world validation
no objects added/removed; count correction not implemented
ambiguity flag is heuristic, not a calibrated probability
paired errors lock baseline GT identities; recall is independently rematched
